<!--
  The questions of FaqSplit as cards: the topic, the question, the answer and a read-more link; with an icon
  square on top in the icons shape. Shapes: grid3, grid4, icons (three columns).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Question, FaqSplitLabels } from "../blocks/faq-split.types";

  export type FaqCardsProps = {
    items: Question[];
    labels: FaqSplitLabels;
    cards?: "grid3" | "grid4" | "icons";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import ArticleBlock from "../components/article-block.svelte";

  let { items, labels, cards = "grid3" }: FaqCardsProps = $props();
</script>

<Box
  class={
    (cards as string) === "grid4" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4"
    : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
  }
  data-testid="faq"
>
  {#each items as q (q.id)}
    <ArticleBlock class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex flex-col gap-4 p-6" testid="faq-card">
      {#if ((cards as string) === "icons")}
        <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
          <LucideIcon name={q.icon} size={20} />
        </Box>
      {/if}
      <Stack gap="2">
        <Badge variant="secondary" size="sm" class="w-fit">
          {q.category}
        </Badge>
        <Title as={3} size="base" weight="semibold">
          {q.question}
        </Title>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {q.answer}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
      <Box class="mt-auto">
        <Link href="#/faq" variant="default" size="sm" class="font-medium">
          {labels.more}
          <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" size={16} />
        </Link>
      </Box>
    </ArticleBlock>
  {/each}
</Box>
